entities.name: Dmytro Mytrofanov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dmytro Yuriyovych Mytrofanov is a Ukrainian middleweight professional boxer. He won the national title in 2008 and 2012 and a bronze medal at the 2011 European Championships. He competed at the 2016 Olympics, but was eliminated in the first bout.
